<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude oil impact:</strong> Brent crude prices exceeding $108 per barrel are stoking inflation concerns and pressuring the rupee, prompting experts to anticipate a risk-off sentiment in domestic equities.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxQLVNDN0tfbmQwQ2RQSnhOckF4aFg2SDdWMVVnSVE3SXFNZFU3enJFUHJBR2FwN2FnNXNrR2RlZ0RSN3FJY2VPYnNxQUNrcERqbjlsV1BnUVBmb0NkLUJKZUplXzZpallnNmRjNERCenYydzdBejBUV3lvWUNNMHBHamRZTmFiRXdzRXkwN2dHWWl2ckU3bVRta1pleDJLTDZjMlU0aw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Liquidity and flows:</strong> FIIs have offloaded ₹14,475 crore in Indian shares this month, while the RBI’s ₹1 lakh crore Open Market Operation (OMO) remains a critical focus for managing bank liquidity and stabilizing bond yields.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google._?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market performance:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty have shed nearly ₹5 lakh crore in market capitalization over the last five days, with indices slipping below key moving averages.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
